title: I Said Your Name Tonight
prompt:
[Intro: soft piano, warm pad]

[Verse 1: gentle female voice]
I said your name tonight
Out loud, in the dark, by the bed
Said it slow, said it twice
Said some things I've never said

I told him how you take your coffee
How you hum when you're afraid
How you've been so tired lately
I said your name, and stayed

[Chorus: strings rise]
I said your name tonight
To the one who hung the stars
I don't have the words to fix it
But I know whose hands you're in, and whose we are
I can't carry you. He can.
So I said your name tonight

[Verse 2: voice a little stronger]
He knows what a fever is
He's touched a hand and watched it leave
He's stopped a funeral in the street
And told a mother not to grieve

He's had friends who couldn't stay awake
To pray with him one night
So I stayed up. I said your name.
To Jesus. Till the light.

[Chorus: strings and soft drums]
I said your name tonight
To the one who hung the stars
I don't have the words to fix it
But I know whose hands you're in, and whose we are
I can't carry you. He can.
So I said your name tonight

[Bridge: choir enters, building]
Healing, if he will, and I'm asking that he will
Peace, if it's a while. Him beside you, still.
Your name. I said it. Your name. Again.
Your name. He knows it. Amen.

[Final Chorus: full choir, then just her]
I said your name tonight
To the one who hung the stars
I don't have the words to fix it
But I know whose hands you're in, and whose we are
I can't carry you. He can.
So I said your name tonight

[Outro: piano, whispered]
And for me, too.
